notes: Mainline studios use key.workspaceId empty string "".
Workspace.responses.values is keyed by request_id; success messages often say Build <uuid> where uuid equals the map key (request_id == buildId on this tenant for builds).
BUILD_STATE_IN_PROGRESS exists in protobuf but was not present in historical WorkspaceBuild/all dump.

poll_contract.after_REQUEST_START_BUILD: Poll GET Workspace?key.workspaceId= until responses.values[<request_id>] appears; buildId is typically that same request_id. Then GET WorkspaceBuild?key.workspaceId=&key.buildId= until state in {BUILD_STATE_SUCCESS, BUILD_STATE_FAIL, BUILD_STATE_CANCELED} (also treat IN_PROGRESS as non-terminal).
poll_contract.workspace_staleness: Submit proof-of-review must use Workspace lastModifiedAt (or similar), not immutable WorkspaceBuild alone

keyed_get.Studio: GET /api/resources/studio/v1/Studio?key.studioId=<id>&key.workspaceId=  → 200 on mainline; includes template + inputSchema
keyed_get.StudioConfig: GET .../StudioConfig?key.studioId=&key.workspaceId= → 404 on mainline empty workspaceId (confirmed TOPOLOGY, studio-authentication). Use Studio for keyed mainline get; StudioConfig/all still used for search streams.

studioconfig_all.note: StudioConfig/all has no mainline rows; search mainline via Studio/all or keyed Studio GET.
